newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts aim higher if 115-02 support intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts aim higher if 115-02 support intact.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE are consolidating in a wide range but while above key 115-02 support their chances for upside remain intact, analysts said on Tuesday.
Nico Bakker, technical analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, said while 115-02 held, the gilt contract could rechallenge the all-time peak of 115-25 reached on July 23.
"If it breaks 115-25 the next target will be 116-00," said Bakker, adding that level was the price objective based on the previous trading range.
At 0700 GMT, September gilts opened 6/32 lower at 115-14.
Analysts said while confined to a range betweeen 115-02 and 115-14 now, gilts could still be prone to fluctuation after the UK June consumer credit and U.S. employment cost data later.
Bakker said in the larger picture, charts suggested a rise towards 118-00, based on an upward channel on the weekly chart.
If 115-02 failed, good support would come into the picture at the 113-30, area which is a bottom formed in mid-July.

Three Fibonnacci levels could also intervene on the downside, Bakker said. These were 114-06, which is a 38.2 percent retracement of the up move from end May to 115-25, 113-23 which is 50 percent, and 113-07 which is 61.8 percent.
Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, said the outlook for gilts was friendly but he expected the market to browse between 115-04/06 and 115-14 on Tuesday.
A corrective phase could extend down to 114-22, which is trendline support, and below there to the late June bottom of 113-25, but technical indicators looked mostly constructive.
A break of 115-14, the high on Monday, could stoke the market higher to the 115-25 peak and above there the next objective was 116-00, Cossor said.
At the short end, December short sterling was quoted unchanged on the day at 92.62.
